title: Choose the visual world for Storage
question: You asked for a modern app built like an Apple engineer would. Three takes on that, plus the plain category standard.

options.label: System App
options.lineage: Apple's own utilities: Find My, Files, Reminders
options.thesis: Feels like Apple shipped it: large titles, inset grouped lists, one tint color, and Find My's question answered instantly: where is it?
options.viewport: Phone: large-title search, then Recent Boxes as a horizontal row, then a grouped list of recently added items with photo thumbnails; a floating Scan button and an Add sheet that slides up.
options.risk: So native it can feel like an Apple demo app unless the label designer and scan moments get real craft.

options.label: Photo-First Registrar
options.lineage: museum collection records, polished like Apple Photos and the Apple Store app
options.thesis: The photo is the record: big object photography on quiet neutral ground, with the number set in monospace like an accession tag.
options.viewport: Phone: a photo grid of items with name and box under each; tap a photo and it expands into a full record card showing box, location and the printed label.
options.risk: Relies on decent photos; items without photos look like gaps until the AI fills them in.

options.label: Home-Style Tiles
options.lineage: Apple Home and Shortcuts: rooms and actions as colored tiles
options.thesis: Locations and boxes as tiles you tap, each location with its own color, so the garage always looks like the garage.
options.viewport: Phone: a grid of location tiles (Garage, Attic, Closet) with box counts; tap one and its boxes appear as tiles; Scan and Add in the tab bar.
options.risk: Browsing by place is great; finding by search must not get buried under the tiles.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What Sortly, Homebox and Itemit ship, done at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Tab bar, search on top, recent items as photo cards.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from other inventory apps by design.
